reading.a: A man in a bright yellow jacket (element 3, box [103, 0, 540, 799]) peeks out from behind a tree trunk at the left (element 1, box [0, 0, 224, 799], the nearest element), against soft green and white bokeh.
reading.b: A café snapshot: the man nearest the camera stands at the left holding up a phone (element 10, box [0, 268, 432, 799]), a woman in green behind his raised hand, a woman in black smiling at the right, in front of a cream brick wall and a monstera.

concepts.idea: With no camera move, in this order: while the yellow man stays where he is, the tree slides out to the left and the whole café, its wall, monstera and both women, arrives behind him brightest-first (t 0.05-0.5); then the man glides onto the nearest man's place over the café (t 0.30-0.44), turns to the camera as himself (k1, t 0.55), takes the nearest man's pose and raised phone with his own face (k3, t 0.67), becomes the nearest man in a yellow shirt (k2, t 0.83) and then the nearest man as he is (t 0.92).

anchors.how: His pairing, unchanged: the yellow man goes to the person nearest the camera.

transforms.name: bokeh_to_cafe
transforms.note: The lead, not a beat (round-11 rule): A's green and white bokeh takes the café wall's and the monstera's colours, ending with the café's arrival at t 0.5 (round 10 ended it at 0.55), so his 'background of A just fades into them' becomes a background that is already the café's colour when the café's own pixels replace it.

transforms.name: tree_goes_away
transforms.note: Beat 1, his 'the tree from frame A go away', window unchanged. Answers 'two girls in the background of B are visible through the cut and just stay there': hole_reveal false, so where the trunk stood the base shows A's plate and then the café as the end effect brings it, never B through the trunk's outline. Beat 1 runs together with the end effect: the café arrives as the tree leaves.

transforms.name: man_becomes_nearest_man
transforms.note: Beat 2 (the glide, the chain's rigid lead) and beat 3 (the identity change through his three keyframes, which he called promising). Answers 'hard cutting': depth front composites the man after the end effect, so the café is already the base when he moves and no footprint is vacated. Answers 'really ugly linear 2d move of cut man': the lead now moves him by his face onto k1's face (round-11 rule) under his soft matte, over the café, and is short. Answers 'very jittery morphs only part of face ( also ugly and distorted )': after the lead the matte is the moved matte joined with B's man's matte, dilated by matte_grow 0.03, so no matte edge crosses the face, and face_guide aligns the two faces before each segment's flow (damp 0.5 by default). Spans in clip time (a clip of about 3.0 s, linear in the window): the lead t 0.30-0.44, 0.41 s; the turn to k1 t 0.44-0.55, 0.33 s; k1 to k3 t 0.55-0.67, 0.37 s; k3 to k2 t 0.67-0.83, 0.47 s; k2 to B t 0.83-0.92, 0.28 s. All five are tonight's test spans unchanged.

helper.what: Three generated in-betweens of the man only, used inside his matte: A's man turned at B's man's place (k1), A's face on B's man's pose and phone in a yellow T-shirt (k3), and B's man in a yellow T-shirt (k2); the café, the two women, the tree and the bokeh come from the two photos, and both end frames are original.

knobs.name: end_effect.window
knobs.what: When the café arrives behind the man; it must be complete before the glide starts at t 0.30 in the places the man leaves, or a strip of A's plate shows beside him.

knobs.name: man_becomes_nearest_man.params.times
knobs.what: When the moved picture, k1, k3 and k2 are reached in the chain; each span stays within a tenth of tonight's test.

knobs.name: man_becomes_nearest_man.params.damp
knobs.what: How much of the flow is kept between two face-aligned keyframes; lower makes the segment more of a plain aligned dissolve, higher more of a warp (and more jitter if the flow is unreliable).

concepts.risk: F1 double exposure: the segments between keyframes are dissolves, aligned by the faces but still dissolves; k1 to k3 (0.37 s) and k3 to k2 (0.47 s) change the body and then the face, so watch t 0.55-0.83 for two faces or two shirts at half strength inside the matte; k2 to B (0.28 s) is the shortest and changes the face again. The end effect is a luma reveal of the whole background (t 0.05-0.5), so the café still arrives as a brightest-first dissolve of A's bokeh, now behind the man rather than through a hole; he may still read it as 'background of A just fades into them'. F2 decoration: the lead is still a rigid move of A's man (0.41 s); if the face-landmark similarity pulls him diagonally or the soft matte is missing (INFO matte line), it is the 'linear 2d move of cut man' again. The grown matte (0.03 of the width, about 18 px) carries keyframe pixels of the café around him; if a keyframe's café differs from B's, a halo shows at his shoulders during t 0.44-0.92. F3 invention: the keyframes are generated; A's face is carried by k1 and k3 inside his matte, and the page must say so.
